question: def(W(3,5)) = fewest lines missed by a 26-set (ovoid size q^2+1)

lowerBound.argument: deficiency 5 is impossible: the line-eigenvector relation A_line d = (q-1)d forces |supp d| >= 2q, and equality delta = q is EXACTLY the punctured-pencil dipole, which Holotrade a41a53f proved infeasible at q=5. Deficiency 6 is impossible: every such defect must be the difference of two full six-line pencils at noncollinear centres, and the unique PSp orbit target is infeasible.

annealing.reading: 60 independent guided-annealing runs never beat 12. Evidence that def(5) = 12, not proof: local search is not a decision procedure and has missed optima in this repository before.

defEqualsQ.why: the proved lower bound is 6, so def(5) > q

thetaMinusAlpha.why: 8 is now the BOTTOM of the interval [7,12] plus one; still not decided

whatDefQEqualsQReallyIs: the support bound gives def(q) >= q, tight at q=3 where the dipole attains it and provably not tight at q=5. So 'def(q) = q' was the LOWER BOUND being tight at q=3, never the value.
boundary: def(5) is not determined here. The annealing floor is reported as evidence and is explicitly not a claim; all three exact tests are UNKNOWN.
